'''Celia Deane-Drummond''' is director of the Laudato Si’ Research Institute and senior research fellow in Theology at [[Campion Hall, Oxford]], and Professor of Contemporary Catholic Theology at the [[Faculty of Theology and Religion, University of Oxford]]. She teaches systematic theology in relation to biological science - especially evolution, ecology, and genetics; bioethics - especially sustainability, ecotheology, and public theology.

Deane-Drummond gained a BA from the [[Girton College, Cambridge]] in natural sciences, and received her PhD in plant physiology at the [[University of Reading]] in 1980. During the 1980s she was a lecturer in plant physiology at [[Durham University]].<ref name="FI">{{cite web |url=https://www.faraday.cam.ac.uk/about/people/prof-celia-deane-drummond/ |title=Prof. Celia Deane-Drummond |publisher=Faraday Institute, Cambridge University |access-date=13 March 2026}}</ref> She later took a BA in theology from [[Trinity College, Bristol]], then moved to [[Manchester University]] to take a PhD in systematic theology.<ref name="FI" />

In 2000 she was appointed to a professorship in theology and the biological sciences at the [[University of Chester]] which she held until 2011. She was professor of theology at the [[University of Notre Dame]] from 2011 to 2019.<ref name="LAFST">{{cite web |url=https://luthscitech.org/celia-deane-drummond-evangelical-lutheran-church-in-america/ | title=Celia Deane-Drummond | publisher=Lutheran Alliance for Faith, Science and Technology | year=2010}}</ref> In 2018, she founded the  [[Laudato Si' Research Institute]] at Campion Hall in Oxford, where she is the current director. She is also the editor of the international journal ''[[:de:Philosophy, Theology and the Sciences|Philosophy, Theology and the Sciences]]''.<ref>[https://www.christianflourishing.com/celia-deane-drummond Celia Deane-Drummond] from the Human Flourishing Research Project, retrieved 19 February 2021</ref>

Her books include: 
* Creation Through Wisdom: Theology and the New Biology (2003)
* Genetics and Christian Ethics (2006)
* Ecotheology (2008)
* Christ and Evolution (2009)
* Religion and Ecology in the Public Sphere (joint ed.) (2011)<ref name=wc>[http://www.worldcat.org/wcidentities/lccn-no96-54363   WorldCat Identities]</ref>
* The Wisdom of the Liminal: Evolution and Other Animals in Human Becoming (2014)
* A Primer in Ecotheology: Theology for a Fragile Earth (2017)
* Shadow Sophia: The Evolution of Wisdom, Volume II (2021)
* Morality's Future and the Transcendent: The Evolution of Wisdom, Volume III (2026)
